Projects.title: Projects
Projects.subtitle: Take a look at our Projects
Projects.quote: You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great
Projects.villance_desc: A streamlined and fast hotel booking website that allows users to browse hotels with ratings, nightly prices, and detailed room information. Users can apply advanced filters based on location, price, or rating. The platform also offers features such as adding hotels to favorites, viewing detailed hotel pages, completing bookings, and reviewing previous and upcoming reservations.
Projects.economics_title: Faculty of Economics - A A U
Projects.economics_desc: The Faculty of Economics at Al Zaeem Al Azhari University is a leading academic institution dedicated to preparing qualified economic professionals capable of contributing to economic and social development. The visual identity of the faculty was professionally designed to reflect its academic vision, strengthen its institutional presence, and unify its visual appearance across all platforms and media materials in a modern style that represents excellence and professionalism.
Projects.zus_desc: An e-commerce store showcasing a wide range of clothing and accessories for men and women. Users can filter products by gender, category (t-shirt, pants, shoes, etc.), or brand. They can add items to favorites, view full product details, and add them to the shopping cart for later checkout. The design is clean and user-friendly, offering a smooth shopping experience.
Projects.abda_desc: A comprehensive marketing campaign that includes a website, graphic design materials, and educational posters. The initiative aims to provide essential and updated information to fresh graduates to help them prepare for the job market, as well as guidance for students applying for scholarships in Europe, China, and other countries. The project combines awareness, design, and valuable content in an accessible and engaging way.
Projects.bareq_desc: A corporate website for a consulting company that showcases its services, advantages, vision, and mission. The site includes information about the company’s founding story, an introductory video, social media links, phone contact details, and a geographical location map. Its goal is to present a professional image and build trust with potential clients.
Projects.abwab_desc: Abwab is an integrated digital marketplace in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia that brings together new and used items in one platform. The app allows users to easily list, buy, and sell a wide range of products, including electronics, furniture, vehicles, real estate, and various services. Abwab features a simple and user-friendly interface, along with smart search and categorization options that help users quickly find what they are looking for. The app aims to simplify the buying and selling experience by providing a safe, efficient, and value-driven marketplace within the Saudi market.
Projects.madaghut_desc: Madghout Zawaya is a Saudi restaurant specializing in serving some of the finest dishes, with a focus on authentic local cuisine and rich flavors that reflect Saudi culinary heritage. The restaurant is committed to delivering a distinctive dining experience through high-quality food, authentic taste, and excellent service in a comfortable and welcoming atmosphere.
Projects.badr_desc: Badr Alqahtani Gold Mining Company is a mining company headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, specializing in gold exploration, extraction, and development. The company is committed to delivering high-quality mining operations through modern techniques, skilled expertise, and strict adherence to safety and sustainability standards. With a forward-looking vision, the company aims to contribute to the mining sector by creating long-term value, ensuring operational excellence, and responsibly developing natural resources.
Projects.speed_desc: Speed Travel Agency is a professional travel and tourism agency that provides comprehensive services including flight bookings, tour arrangements, visa processing, hotel reservations, and corporate travel solutions. The agency focuses on delivering a smooth and reliable travel experience through competitive offers, excellent customer service, and professional trip planning tailored to clients’ needs.
Projects.eatc_desc: Excellence Training Center is a professional training institute that offers specialized programs across various fields, aiming to enhance skills and improve the performance of individuals and organizations. The center emphasizes high-quality training content, experienced instructors, and modern teaching methods aligned with current job market demands to build competent and successful professionals.
Projects.step_one_desc: Reach out through our website or phone to request the service
Projects.step_two_desc: We listen carefully and define your project requirements
Projects.step_three_desc: Our team carries out the required work with high efficiency
Projects.step_four_desc: We deliver the final work and follow up to ensure your satisfaction
Projects.matajri_desc: Matajri is a mini ERP system built for tailoring shops. It gives shop owners everything they need to run the business in one place: accounting, inventory management, financial reports, per-employee performance statistics and customer management.

FAQ.title: FAQ
FAQ.subtitle: What's on your mind?
FAQ.q_one_desc: We offer website and online store development, ERP systems for accounting and inventory, graphic design and visual identity, brand building, content writing and social media management.
FAQ.q_two: How long does it take to complete a project?
FAQ.q_two_desc: The duration depends on the size and complexity of the project, but we always stick to agreed timelines.
FAQ.q_three_desc: Yes, we offer support and maintenance plans to ensure your project keeps running smoothly.
FAQ.q_four: How can I get started with you?
FAQ.q_four_desc: You can contact us through the contact form or WhatsApp to share your idea, and we’ll guide you step by step.
FAQ.q_five: Can I make changes after the project is delivered?
FAQ.q_five_desc: Yes, modifications can be made after delivery as part of the support plan or a new agreement depending on the scope.
FAQ.q_six_desc: Prices vary depending on the type and size of the project, but we always provide a clear and fair quote.
FAQ.q_seven: Do you build ERP and accounting systems?
FAQ.q_seven_desc: Yes. We build custom ERP systems covering accounting, inventory, financial reports, employee statistics and customer management, such as “Matajri” for tailoring shops.
FAQ.q_eight: Do you serve clients outside Saudi Arabia?
FAQ.q_eight_desc: Yes. We serve clients across Saudi Arabia and the Gulf, as well as Sudan, Egypt and the Levant, and we work remotely with clients in Europe, the US, Canada and Australia.
